description: Generalize the proven Postgres review_jobs reliability model into a portable durable-job port and services/worker runtime while preserving Codecamp review behavior; bind handlers to capabilities only after the kernel is accepted.
deviation_notes: Task 1 was reopened by independent review on 2026-07-22 for build-context and coverage-evidence findings. Producer remediation and fresh independent re-review closed WKR-T1-H1 and WKR-T1-L1 with engine-level context proof, truthful combined coverage, quality gates, and exact-image runtime evidence. Parent-orchestrator acceptance completed Task 1. Task 2 established the current executable review_jobs baseline. Task 3 fixed the compatibility boundary and accepted deliberate strengthenings: lease-token ownership, active-lease-safe enqueue/replay, replay audit, retryable webhook failure on enqueue loss, adapter-only DB access, and reversible generic-table adoption. Task 4 added provider-neutral Zod handler/envelope/lifecycle contracts and least-privilege enqueue, worker, dead-letter, and replay ports. Independent review reopened Task 4 for missing dead-letter visibility, replay authorization evidence, tenant scope, temporary patch artifacts, dead-summary attempt bounds, and a parse defect; every finding was reproduced or verified, remediated, and closed by a fresh final PASS. No schema, migration, PostgreSQL adapter, worker loop, live-locking claim, or Task 5 implementation is attributed to Task 4; Task 5 remains pending.
